Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the approved giant Schwaben Redoubt boss design, not a background to include. Production transparent RGBA sprite atlas for HEAD-ON. Preserve the approved reference's crisp detailed hand-painted brown/olive WWI steel, rivets and weathered concrete style. EXACT orthographic vertical 90-degree TOP VIEW: camera looking straight down, no visible front elevation faces, no oblique/isometric/cinematic perspective. Weapons point toward image TOP/north AND are elevated steeply toward the SKY like anti-aircraft guns, so barrels are shortened/foreshortened from this overhead camera and the upward-facing muzzle rims can be seen. Never show long horizontal ground-aimed barrels toward viewer/bottom. No text, labels, grid lines, dividers, watermarks, backdrop, checkerboard painted into pixels, floor rectangle, aircraft, fire, smoke or muzzle flashes; all gaps and background genuinely transparent. Every grid cell contains exactly the specified isolated object with generous clear margin. State variants must retain identical physical scale, center, orientation, mechanical pivot and matching silhouette footprint; no cropping and no object crossing a cell boundary. Damage uses bent armor, cracks, exposed gears and broken steel, not enlarged explosions.
Create ONE square 2-by-2 atlas, FOUR equal square cells, ideally 2048x2048. All four cells depict the SAME enormous broad angular fortress FOUNDATION/BODY ONLY, including thick weathered armored central bunker roof, steel bracing, pipes, concrete walls, attached left/right low decks and tiny perimeter sandbag base. Keep the distinctive massive integrated boss silhouette. Completely REMOVE ALL weapon assemblies and upper gun casemate boxes, observation hut/mast, ammo racks/door assembly: these are separate overlay sprites. Leave believable EMPTY circular gun mounting plates at central crown and on each side deck, empty small plates on the two lower flanks, a bare rear-center attachment pad and bare lower-center ammunition doorway pad. Do not leave ghost guns in damaged frames. No large earth/trench/background patch.
Cell order: top-left = intact armored hull with closed central roof, clean readable empty mounts; top-right = same hull damaged, chipped armor, cracks and a few torn roof seams but matching mounts; bottom-left = same hull breached, central armor roof torn open revealing a dark machinery/control cavity, attached outer walls remain; bottom-right = collapsed hull wreck, recognizable same footprint with broken concrete, buckled steel plates and shallow exposed structural beams, compact wreck contained inside the original outline.
All bodies point north and share precisely the same canvas registration. Maintain broad 1.55:1 width/height proportions, body centered in each square, approx 88% cell width and 63% cell height. Stylized boss scale and clear light concrete/dark steel separation, no camouflage swallowing the outline.
